decisions.reason: As a close-to-core web-map plugin with development already sunk, management is inclined to retain it, although its lower visibility and likely niche demand make withdrawal a realistic option if simplification of the portfolio becomes attractive.

Because it was publicly highlighted as a mobile-usability improvement within the core mapping offer, the firm is likely to continue justifying the investment, even if reduced later visibility suggests only moderate market traction.
This platform remains the least likely to be dropped because it was presented as a flagship product line tied to the firm’s strategic direction, which strongly reinforces escalation of commitment.

Its dedicated presentation and close fit with enterprise geospatial workflows support continued commitment, though maintaining a fuller application is more demanding than keeping a small plugin and therefore somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning.
